author: golem
body:
# Existing clean-quit examples for the same source review

Root confirms retained build/fx062/fixture/profile.py finally uses SIGTERM at line241. If the original frontend does not handle that through ordinary SDL shutdown, the new interposer's atexit/SDL_Quit summary cannot become valid on that normal harness path. Do not label that expected missing finalization a valid full diagnostic or modify the frozen original evidence.

Existing successful clean SDL-quit patterns are visible read-only in /Agon/mystuff/agon-fsim/utilities/pingo-vdplet-rows/app_check_rgb.py (commands.write quit, normal wait, signal only on failure) with helper utilities/stock-vdp-bulk/source/capture.c, and /Agon/mystuff/agon-6502/experiments/vdp005/color/recovery_review/mos_test.py with experiments/vdp005/apple/mos_keys.c. The latter injector's quit-only route may be simpler than frame capture. Do not import extra backend/private/frame observers merely to quit.

You may assess and freeze a narrow normal-SDL-quit derivative for the new owned diagnostic after the final measured phase, retaining the original SIGTERM helper/raw unchanged and reporting added event-observation/teardown overhead. Guest validations and exact frontend/backend/firmware must remain unchanged. This is source/host preparation only; target/audio execution still needs a new central grant after Author reviews. If a clean finalization route needs a larger behavioral change or is already covered, report the actual source evidence and proposed scope rather than silently broadening it.
